# Habitinator

> Cross-platform habits, dailies, and to-dos with focus timer and statistics.

Habitinator is a productivity app (Blazor web + .NET MAUI). User board data is private and requires authentication; this file describes public surfaces only.

## Product

- Live app: https://habitinator.app/
- Source: https://github.com/tothKarolyDavid/Habitinator
- README: https://github.com/tothKarolyDavid/Habitinator#readme

## Public pages

- `/` — landing for signed-out visitors (sign in / register / demo guest)
- `/auth/login` — sign in
- `/auth/register` — create account
- `/privacy` — privacy policy

## API (authenticated)

- OpenAPI: https://habitinator.app/openapi/v1.json
- API catalog: https://habitinator.app/.well-known/api-catalog
- Board REST API under `/api/board` (JWT or cookie auth)
- Health: https://habitinator.app/health

## Privacy

Authentication uses session cookies and optional JWT for native clients. No third-party advertising trackers on the web app.

## Security

Report vulnerabilities: https://habitinator.app/.well-known/security.txt
